title: Interlocking Stratagems

source.chapter: Interlocking Stratagems — the case is the chained ships of Red Cliff in the novel Romance of the Three Kingdoms (fiction, not official history)
source.quote: When the foe is many and strong, do not meet him head-on: let him tie himself down, and his momentum dies. The army keeps its order and wins heaven’s favour.

moral: Arrange one thing after another with no gap — that is what holds it all together.
